intro: Vancouver's election results remain unofficial, the AI infrastructure trade faces a major earnings test, and China's proposed AI export controls deserve attention. Monday edition, researched this morning.

weather.title: Cloudy with occasional rain
weather.summary: Monday forecast: around 14°C high and 6°C low, with periods of rain. Tuesday looks sunnier, roughly 16°C. Check the current forecast before heading out.

stories.title: Vancouver election: unofficial results published
stories.summary: City Hall has published unofficial 2026 municipal election results. Official certification is still pending, so treat the current council lineup as provisional.

stories.title: AI stocks face a consequential earnings week
stories.summary: Investors are increasingly scrutinizing AI infrastructure spending, financing and free cash flow. Semiconductor shares have recently been under pressure; earnings and spending guidance are the signals to watch.

stories.title: US federal agency orders removal of DeepSeek technology
stories.summary: The Department of Homeland Security has directed removal of DeepSeek technology from federal civilian IT systems, highlighting procurement and trust issues around AI supply chains.

stories.title: China proposes export controls on sensitive AI technologies
stories.summary: The draft covers 23 AI technology categories, with public consultation through November 15. Public open-source technologies are reported to remain largely exempt; final wording matters.

stories.title: Vancouver Writers Fest runs through October 25
stories.summary: More than 90 events with local and international authors are listed for the festival. A useful local cultural option for this week.

events.title: Vancouver Writers Fest

meetups.title: Vancouver Physical AI Workshop
meetups.description: Robotics and sensor datasets, vision model evaluation, hands-on work. Very relevant to your robotics projects; work email required for workshop access.

meetups.title: Vancouver Robotics Club
meetups.description: Show-and-tell of robotics and electronics builds; an easy venue to discuss your Raspberry Pi robot.

meetups.title: Global Summit AI Vancouver
meetups.description: Two-day AI conference with agents, AI infrastructure, engineering and startup discussions. Evaluate ticket price before committing.

meetups.title: AI Builders Guild
meetups.description: Free builder-focused meetup with demos and talks. Strong fit for meeting potential collaborators and showing Nekoni or Embedible.

meetups.title: Official Cybersecurity Summit Vancouver
meetups.description: Enterprise security leaders and practitioners; registration is subject to approval.

meetups.title: Vancouver AI Community Meetup
meetups.description: Local AI community demos, short talks, and networking. Good opportunity to connect with builders and possibly demo a project.

dining.title: The Moon: intimate martini bar and restaurant
dining.description: A new 27-seat dining room and dedicated martini bar at 59 Powell St, with chef Felix Maristany (formerly Kissa Tanto). A promising spot to try for cocktails and a quieter dinner.

dining.title: AnnaLena becomes Vancouver's first two-star restaurant
dining.description: Michelin has awarded the restaurant a second star. Worth considering for a special dinner; a notable shift in the city's fine-dining scene.

dining.title: Published on Main launches 12-course Harvest menu
dining.description: A $170-per-person tasting menu featuring autumn ingredients such as wild mushrooms, quince, and sunchoke. Listed as available through January 5, 2027.
